warn resource-not-carried: the task definition ApiTask defines the container log-router beside its main container api, and the Amazon ECS Recipes of the catalog run one container, the main one — the one a service's load balancer names, else the first essential one, else the first — so log-router is not carried: run it as a component of its own
warn resource-not-carried: ApiRule (AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule) is not carried; a listener rule forwarding to a target group is the operator's load balancer's, as the target group is, and the hub holds no Feature realizing public ingress for Amazon ECS that would carry it; it reads ApiTargets at Properties.Actions.0.TargetGroupArn and Listener at Properties.ListenerArn; nothing is drafted for it, so where it is wanted, apply it to the deployed resources outside the draft
warn resource-not-carried: ApiTargets (AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup) is not carried; a target group is the operator's load balancer's: the server Recipe on Amazon ECS takes one by its ARN under infra.overrides.TargetGroupArn, and the hub holds no Feature realizing public ingress for Amazon ECS that would carry it, so a service's TargetGroupArn reading it is not written and is reported value-not-carried: set infra.overrides.TargetGroupArn in the Release to the ARN of a target group of the operator's load balancer; nothing is drafted for it, so where it is wanted, apply it to the deployed resources outside the draft

info resource-drafted-from-source: the resource OrdersDbParams of the type AWS::RDS::DBParameterGroup is drafted from the source as the Component imported/datastore/aws-rds-dbparametergroup and the Recipe aws-rds-dbparametergroup on cloudformation, carrying the properties the source writes; the decision's swap hint names the import drafting it from the vendor's schema
warn substrate-left-to-operator: the source creates substrate the draft leaves to the operator and drafts nothing for: AppLogs (AWS::Logs::LogGroup), of which the format says a log group is the operator's: the compute Recipes read one by name under infra.overrides, as awslogs-group and LogGroup, which the Release leaves for its answers file, the comment above the key naming the resource; Balancer (AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer), of which the format says a load balancer and its listeners are the operator's: the server Recipe on Amazon ECS registers its tasks with a target group of it, which the operator names under infra.overrides.TargetGroupArn, reading the parameter Subnets at Properties.Subnets; Cluster (AWS::ECS::Cluster), of which the format says the Amazon ECS cluster a service runs in is the operator's: the Amazon ECS Recipes take it by its name or ARN under infra.overrides.Cluster, which the Release leaves for its answers file, the comment above the key naming the resource; Listener (AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener), of which the format says a load balancer and its listeners are the operator's: the server Recipe on Amazon ECS registers its tasks with a target group of it, which the operator names under infra.overrides.TargetGroupArn, reading ApiTargets at Properties.DefaultActions.0.TargetGroupArn and Balancer at Properties.LoadBalancerArn; provide each where the Release deploys, and fill the pointers the Release leaves for them
